question: What does a typical project cost?
answer: Most full-home interiors land between PKR 2,500–6,000 per square foot depending on materials and joinery scope. Café and office fit-outs usually range PKR 3,500–8,000. After one site visit we give you a written range — and we hold it.

question: How long does a project take?
answer: A single room refresh runs 4–6 weeks. A full apartment or villa: 3–5 months. A café or office fit-out: 8–14 weeks. You receive a written schedule before we start, with milestones you can track.

question: What happens in the first consultation?
answer: We visit your space (or video-call for remote projects), listen to how you use it, and talk budget openly. Within two working days you receive a summary with scope options and honest price ranges — free of charge.

question: Do you work outside Lahore?
answer: Yes. We deliver projects across Pakistan — recent work in Islamabad and Karachi — and remote design packages worldwide. Site supervision visits are scheduled around project milestones.

question: Can I see my space before it is built?
answer: Always. Our 3D Studio produces daylight-accurate views and walkthroughs of every major room. Nothing goes into production until you have approved the visuals and the drawings behind them.

question: What does the 10-year joinery warranty cover?
answer: Every bespoke piece made in our workshop — kitchens, wardrobes, vanities, shelving, doors — is covered against structural failure, delamination and hardware defects for ten years, parts and labour.

question: Where do materials come from?
answer: Plywood and hardware from vetted Pakistani and imported suppliers, solid oak and walnut from certified sources, and stone from local quarries we visit ourselves. Samples are presented in person before ordering.

question: How do payments work?
answer: Typically 30% to begin design, 40% on design approval and materials order, and 30% on handover. Large fit-outs are milestone-based. Everything is invoiced, receipted and documented.

question: Do you handle approvals and contractors?
answer: Yes — society approvals, MEP engineers, licensed contractors and site safety all sit under our project management. You get one point of contact and one responsible contract.

question: Can you work with my architect or existing drawings?
answer: Happily. We collaborate with architects and structural engineers regularly, and we can build directly from existing drawing sets after a coordination review.
